decision_conditions: <span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">The proposed two-storey side extension, by reason of its design particularly when in conjunction with the other proposed and approved extensions, would present a discordant feature </span></span><span style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">which introduces a staggered roofline and unbalances the symmetry across the semi-detached pair, thus does not have regard to the existing form of the host dwelling or semi-detached pair. Furthermore, it would present a substandard bedroom which </span></span></span><span style="font-size: medium;"></span><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">does not comply with the relevant space standards for ensuring adequate quality of accommodation for residents.&nbsp;</span></span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">As such, the proposed development is contrary to: - National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp; National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024);&nbsp; -Policies D1, D4, D5 and D6 of the London Plan (March 2021)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;-Policies DMD1, DMD5 and SP2 of the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024); and&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;- The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (February 2012).</span>
description: Conversion of the garage into a habitable space including replacement of the existing garage door with a window and construction of a front porch, a single storey rear and side extension and a first floor rear and side extension
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
